BrochureContent.Content:
DNG Thornton Properties are delighted to present Hillview House, a truly exceptional countryside residence occupying a magnificent elevated site amidst some of County Wicklow's most breathtaking scenery.

From the moment you arrive, it is clear that this is a home that has been cherished. Beautifully positioned to capture panoramic views across the rolling hills and valleys surrounding Avoca, Hillview House offers an enviable combination of complete tranquillity, privacy and wonderfully versatile family accommodation, all just a short drive from the village and its excellent amenities.

Inside, the home has been thoughtfully designed with family living at its heart. Light-filled reception rooms enjoy uninterrupted countryside views, while the generous layout provides a wonderful balance between formal entertaining spaces and relaxed everyday living. The spacious sitting room offers an inviting retreat, while the heart of the home is undoubtedly the impressive open-plan kitchen and dining area, where a solid fuel stove creates a warm and welcoming atmosphere for family and friends alike.

Flowing seamlessly from the kitchen is a spectacular garden room, flooded with natural light and perfectly positioned to overlook the beautifully landscaped gardens beyond. This wonderful space effortlessly brings the outdoors in and provides an idyllic setting for morning coffee, family gatherings or simply relaxing while enjoying the changing seasons.

The bedroom accommodation is equally impressive, offering generously proportioned rooms with peaceful garden or countryside outlooks. The principal bedroom enjoys the added benefit of its own ensuite bathroom, while the remaining bedrooms are bright, spacious and perfectly suited to modern family life or visiting guests.
The attic room offers further potential for many uses and benefits from a stunning balcony.

To the rear of the property is a garage / block built storage, car port and an art studio, each one of these spaces is versatile and can be used in a myriad of ways.

However, it is once you step outside that Hillview House truly comes into its own.

The beautifully established gardens have been lovingly cultivated over many years to create a private oasis bursting with colour, character and biodiversity. Sweeping lawns, mature trees, flowering borders and secluded seating areas invite you to slow down and appreciate the remarkable surroundings.

For gardening enthusiasts, the grounds offer an exceptional opportunity to embrace a more sustainable lifestyle. A substantial polytunnel, productive vegetable growing areas, mature apple and plum trees, together with a charming wildlife pond, provide everything needed to enjoy homegrown produce throughout the seasons. Whether tending the gardens, harvesting fruit from the orchard or simply listening to birdsong from one of the many peaceful corners, this is outdoor living at its very best.

Beyond the gardens, the uninterrupted views stretch for miles across the Wicklow countryside, creating a constantly changing backdrop that makes every window feel like a framed landscape painting.

Hillview House is far more than simply a beautiful home—it is a place where family memories are made, where nature is on your doorstep and where every season brings something new to enjoy. Properties offering this combination of generous accommodation, exceptional gardens, breathtaking views and such a peaceful rural setting rarely come to the market.

This is a truly special home that must be experienced in person to be fully appreciated.

Grape House - 10.75m x 9.64m
Before you even step inside the main house, Hillview House offers a truly memorable first impression. The delightful Grape House is an exceptional glazed garden room where mature vines drape overhead, creating a wonderfully atmospheric space filled with dappled light throughout the summer months. Enjoying uninterrupted views over the surrounding countryside, it blurs the lines between indoors and out, providing a versatile space to relax, entertain or simply appreciate the peaceful setting.

Kitchen/Living/Dining Room - 4.48m x 12.46m
The charming country kitchen boasts bespoke painted cabinetry, warm timber worktops and a traditional range-style cooker create a welcoming space. A solid fuel stove provides a cosy focal point during the cooler months, while large windows flood the room with natural light and frame delightful views of the gardens beyond. The kitchen flows effortlessly into the adjoining dining and family spaces, making it ideal for modern living and entertaining.Rich timber ceilings, exposed original beams and characterful detailing create an inviting atmosphere, while the open-plan layout allows the room to flow seamlessly into the adjoining living areas.

Utility Room - 3.30m x 3.76m
Designed with practicality in mind, the spacious utility room offers an abundance of storage, preparation space and laundry facilities, ensuring the main kitchen remains a welcoming hub for family and entertaining. Flooded with natural light and overlooking the gardens, it is a highly functional space.

Sitting Room - 4.48m x 3.94m
The beautifully proportioned living room is a wonderfully inviting retreat, full of warmth and character. Exposed ceiling beams and a feature solid fuel stove create a cosy focal point, while large picture windows fill the room with natural light and frame peaceful views of the surrounding gardens. Generously sized yet wonderfully comfortable, it is the perfect place to unwind with family or enjoy quiet evenings by the fire, effortlessly combining traditional charm with everyday comfort.

Lounge - 3.26m x 3.34m
Offering a cosy escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life, this delightful snug is bathed in natural light and enjoys peaceful views of the surrounding gardens. Rich in character with exposed beams and a warm, welcoming atmosphere, it is an ideal space for reading, relaxing or simply unwinding with family and friends.

Bedroom 1 - 3.30m x 3.63m
A bright and spacious principal bedroom enjoying peaceful views over the surrounding gardens.

En-suite - 3.30m x 1.17m
En suite shower room with toilet, wash hand basin and walk in shower.

Bedroom 2 - 3.30m x 3.12m
Another generously proportioned bedroom filled with natural light and enjoying pleasant garden views. Warm, welcoming and thoughtfully laid out, this versatile room is equally suited as a guest bedroom, children's room or comfortable home office.

Bathroom - 3.30m x 1.71m
Large family bathroom with bath, seperate walk in shower, wc and wash hand basin.

Attic room - 4.50m x 6.31m
This attic room is truly special currently used as a bedroom that feels like a private retreat above the home. Generous in both size and character, the room is perfectly positioned to capture uninterrupted views across the surrounding countryside, with glazed doors opening onto a private balcony that seamlessly connects the indoors with the landscape beyond. There is an ensuite and a space for a home office.

Balcony - 2.38m x 3.33m
With exceptional views this balcony will swiftly become your favourite spot for morning coffee.

Studio - 2.99m x 5.20m
This studio space is super versatile and would suit many uses with plenty of natural light and a soid fuel stove.

Shed - 2.99m x 4.50m
Providing extra storage space

Garage - 5.25m x 3.10m
The garage and adjacent building offer further scope for storage on two levels.

Gardens - 
The gardens are every bit as captivating as the home itself. Beautifully landscaped and lovingly nurtured, they combine expansive lawns, mature specimen trees, colourful planting and productive growing areas to create an exceptional outdoor sanctuary. A magnificent lily pond, flourishing orchard, polytunnel and vegetable garden complement the sweeping countryside views, while numerous seating areas invite you to pause and appreciate the peace and beauty of this truly special setting. Every season brings new colour and interest, making these gardens a place to enjoy throughout the year.

Barn - 25ft x 12ft
Large barn previously used as a boat shed now primarily used as hay/ gardening equipment storage.
